sources.title: Alibaba Releases Qwen2.5-Omni-7B: An End-to-end Multimodal AI Model
sources.snippet: Alibaba has launched Qwen2.5-Omni-7B, a unified end-to-end multimodal model in the Qwen series. Uniquely designed for comprehensive multimodal perception, it can process diverse inputs, including text, images, audio, and videos, while generating real-time text and natural speech responses.
